violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: All kitchenware passing through dishmchine, which had a chlorine concentration of “0” ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Have the dishmachine serviced to provide a chlorine residual of 50 -200 ppm, and sanitize all items in the three vat sink after washing in the dishmachine.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: dishmachine.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Have the dishmachine serviced to provide a chlorine residual of 50 -200 ppm, and sanitize all items in the three vat sink after washing in the dishmachine.
